The regional_trajectories contrast_fit slopes (signed_dx_A 0.2757, signed_dy_A 0.0967, signed_dz_A 0.1558, spatial_mass 0.0103) are descriptive complete-window curves with cloned ancestors and non-independent time points, not spatial reward gradients.
